svg.aria-label: virtual-patch-copilot — an agent control plane over the F5 data plane
svg.title: virtual-patch-copilot — an agent control plane over the F5 data plane
svg.desc: A control plane of eight agents turns scan input into a band-aid policy, a code-fix PR, a ledger and signed evidence. It applies, validates and retires that policy on the F5 proxy already sitting between the internet and the untouched origin.
svg.text: an agent control plane for the F5 proxy already in your request path
CONTROL PLANE · WHAT THE COPILOT DECIDES
each verified finding → a band-aid now, a code fix next
it didn't block → diagnose and retry until it does
a code-fix pull request for every finding
every LB change, signed and exportable
gated by a human · snapshot first · rollback on failure
re-fire the finding's own exploit at the live policy
the cure merged — detach the band-aid, close the ledger
DATA PLANE · WHERE THE BAND-AID ACTUALLY ENFORCES
the F5 proxy you already run
the other four decline, each with its reason
the other four decline, each with its reason
the origin — never touched by the band-aid
the code fix lands here, on your schedule
